title: Constant row of the binary Vandermonde matrix
statement: Let $k,n$ be natural numbers, let $\ell$ be a positive natural number, and choose points $\alpha_0,\ldots,\alpha_{n-1}$ in the binary extension field of degree $\ell$. In the binary Vandermonde matrix formed from these points, the row indexed by the constant-row label has entry $1$ in every column.
hypotheses_covered: $\ell$ is a natural number other than zero
A point in the binary extension field is specified for each column
